subject: The 2-minute scan that saves 20 hours
preview_text: Stop wasting weeks debating. One screenshot, 2 minutes, and you'll know what took your friends 20 hours to figure out.
body_paragraphs: You know that sinking feeling when a conversation leaves you unsure if you're overreacting or onto something real? The one that keeps you up at 2 AM replaying texts in your head, asking your friends for their take, and still feeling stuck.

I used to spend 20 hours over two weeks analyzing a single exchange—digging through screenshots, cross-referencing patterns, calling my best friend for a third opinion. But here's the truth: your gut already knows. It just needs confirmation you can trust.

Red Flag Scanner AI does in 2 minutes what used to take me 20 hours. Open the app, screenshot a conversation, and the AI instantly flags gaslighting, love bombing, or manipulation. You get a toxicity score with a breakdown—no more guesswork, no more waiting for friends to reply.

Open the app now and scan one conversation you've been unsure about. See for yourself how fast clarity comes. P.S. The pattern detection across chats is where it gets scary accurate—it catches the same red flag in messages from three weeks ago that you missed.
